{{Capricorn}}

Capricorn is the 2nd month of the [[Gaian calendar]]. It contains 28 days (4 weeks) and corresponds to ISO weeks 5–8.

== Overview ==
Tells the story of the Cambrian up to life on Land
===Etymology===
English ''Capricorn'' "the horned goat" (Latin ''capra'' + ''cornu''). Japanese: {{ill|山羊座|ja|Yagi-za}} “goat-constellation.”  
===Gaiad themes===
Weeks 5–8 (Days [[Capricorn 1]]–[[Capricorn 28]]): **Cambrian Week 1–2**, **Ordovician**, **Silurian-Devonian**—major animal radiations, plants/fungi ashore, and vertebrate innovations.  
===EVENTS===
* [[Capricorn 7]] — Groundhog day  
* [[Capricorn 14]] — [[:Category:Days_that_Valentine’s_Day_falls_on|Valentine’s Day]] / Lupercalia / Chinese New Year  
* [[Capricorn 21]] — [[:Category:Days_that_Kinen-sai_falls_on|Kinen-sai]] (official day)  
* [[Capricorn 28]] — Lantern Festival
